name: Table
purpose: Dense enterprise data. Sort and paging are controlled, empty/loading/error delegate to StateBlock, and the narrow form is declared rather than guessed.

caption.note: Names the table for assistive tech.

columns.note: Each column carries key, header, priority, align, sortable and a value accessor. Its own shape is in $columnProps rather than in props, because the migration flattened it into the component API where it never was one - which is why the parity check reported three phantom missing props on both sides.

sort.note: Controlled — the same component works with server-side sorting.

onSortChange.angular: sort = model<BhTableSort|undefined>() — the two-way binding *is* the change event; a separate output would fire twice

state.note: Replaces the body with a StateBlock across every column.

responsive.note: scroll keeps the grid and scrolls the container — right when the reader is comparing across columns. stack turns each row into term/value pairs via DescriptionList — right at six columns or fewer. priority moves low-priority columns into a per-row disclosure — right for a wide table with one identifying column. Queries are @container, so it responds to its own width and works in a SidePanel.

selection.note: Checkbox column plus a tri-state select-all. Partial resolves to 'select the rest', never to 'clear'.

rowActions.note: Per-row overflow Menu, which already solves focus return.

stickyHeader.note: Column meaning is lost the moment the header scrolls away.

totals.note: Rendered in <tfoot>, so a sort cannot move it into the data.

aria.labelling: From <caption>, which is optional but strongly preferred — an uncaptioned table in a page of tables is unidentifiable in a screen reader’s table list.
aria.focus: The table itself is not focusable. Sortable headers are buttons and are in the tab order; rows are not, unless rowActivated is bound, in which case the row needs its own focusable trigger rather than a click handler on the <tr>.
aria.announcements: aria-sort on the sorted header. The row count is exposed via aria-rowcount rather than announced. Empty, loading and error states delegate to StateBlock inside a full-width cell, and inherit its policy.

numeric.note: Aligns end and sets tabular-nums. Two things always wanted together.

priority.note: What survives when the container narrows, under responsive=priority. Declared by whoever knows the domain.

hideWhenStacked.note: For a column with no value to label, such as actions.
